newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Diana lists at 15.50 baht.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Diana lists at 15.50 baht.

text.p: Diana Department Store Plc will make its debut on the Thai bourse on Wednesday at an initial public offering (IPO) price of 15.50 baht a share, brokers said.
The firm, which will be traded in the commerce sector, offered three million shares in March. Its registered capital was increased to 130 million baht ($5 million) after the offering.
Money raised by the offer will be used to repay company debt, provide investment in its supermarket business and as revolving capital.
But brokers said they did not expect a very strong showing by the stock when it started trading.

"Diana Department isn't expected to debut strongly on Wednesday due to the current sluggishness of the bourse. Also, there are many better quality and cheaper stocks available in the market now," said Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance and Securities.
The Thai stock market hit its lowest close in 5-1/2 years on Tuesday as investor concerns over the sluggish economy and anticipation of weak corporate earnings growth sparked sales. ($1 = 26 baht)
